results.metric: mean exact four-register accuracy where the intervention changed the outcome, on unseen combinations

proof_scope: Finite 4-bit canonical-ISA interventions on held-out combinations, 3 seeds, 5 trained arms, 2500 matched neural update steps/arm/seed. Every frozen checkpoint prediction independently recomputed and matched source results. Earlier heldout-label majority leakage corrected, negative control checked. Exact oracle evaluated via project separate interpreter test.
limitations: Interventional model below passive_rewrite: NO_GAIN relative strongest model comparator.
Passive_rewrite is given oracle rewrite rule; not learned rule inference.
CPU measured on shared host and not identical per arm; training update path and batch sizes equal, but fixed symbolic baselines not physically CPU matched.
Independent oracle test code included with candidate; reviewer reran it and separately recalculated models.
No loops, causal world model, AGI or champion promotion.
Reviewer agent IDs and Git history not cryptographically authenticated.
